items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: The leader is Everett Longstreth, and it’s a Boston based band, as is the Artie Shaw band.

ctx.x: The leader is Everett Longstreth, and it’s a Boston based band, as is the Artie Shaw band. I think Dick Johnson might be doing the clarinet work on that.
Are those bands the property of the Goodman estate? Or how do they work that?
